snippet.title: PlayStation - Simple 1500 Series Vol 005 - The Igo (1998)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
The Igo is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Ken Chen and published by Chat Noir, which was released in Japan in 1998.
